messages:
marta: kicking off May access sweep for signer/decrypt privileges. goal: owner evidence or justified removal for any admin KMS grants. deadline: 2024-05-12 EOD.

hannah: scope? prod + which staging?

marta: prod + payment-related staging. exclude dev/test unless grant is admin-level.

rick: ran a quick query, found 2 cross-account signer grants with no owners. uploaded CSV: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/may-signer-ownerless.csv

auditbot: automated check: 2 ownerless signer grants detected. ticket created: SEC-4011.

samir: i'll trace usage for the signer grants. saw svc-deploy-bot use from an unexpected region last week; will post sanitized logs.

devops: we can snapshot audit logs to cold storage for 365d for correlation. enabling alert-only policy-drift detector today (14d alert-only window).

luis: minor vuln FYI: hsm-agent v2.0.0 had a disclosure; patched hosts should rotate keys if they touch signing ops.

hannah: proposal: entitlement-linter rule that flags ownerless signer grants and creates a 30d advisory auto-expire grant. advisory first, enforce after 30d. keeps ops safe.

devops: ack. will add rule draft to repo and wire advisory notifications to #eng-security. snippet will be alert-only initially.

auditbot: SEC-4011 updated: status=in_progress, owners=[rick,samir,hannah], due=2024-05-12.

marta: action items: owners update the sheet with evidence or mark "no longer required" + re-request path. security will run a short retro after sweep closes. ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
